# Copy-editing notes for `narrative-master-PHASE6.md` (generated by GPT-4o)

The list below is ordered from top to bottom of the source document.  Each bullet contains (1) an approximate location cue and (2) the recommended edit.  Line numbers reference the **current** markdown file version as of 2026-02-27.

---

## Global / style-wide

- Use a single, consistent heading style: sentence-case for narrative headings (e.g. “Chapter 3: Kingdom dashboard” → “Chapter 3: Kingdom Dashboard”).
- Check that all lesson-opener sub-headings begin with the same emoji and a space.  A few later chapters use “📖Lesson Opener” (missing space).
- Remove double spaces after periods; there are ~75 occurrences throughout.
- Replace straight quotes with curly quotes **or** keep straight quotes everywhere—currently mixed.
- Ensure en-dash vs em-dash usage is consistent (em-dash without surrounding spaces is recommended in this doc).
- Many lists use “-” and “*” interchangeably; pick one list marker.
- Delete trailing whitespace at EOLs (present in ~120 places).
- When citing code (`<strong>` tags, `**bold**`, or back-ticks) make usage consistent; prefer back-ticks for code terms, bold for character names, and *italics* for emphasis.

## Front-matter & Titles

- l.1 `# React Learning Stories - Complete Narrative Master Document` → Change hyphen to em-dash or colon for consistency: “React Learning Stories — Complete Narrative Master Document”.
- l.3 `*Phase 6: Unified LP1-15 | Combined February 26, 2026*` → Replace “|” with “—” or “•” to avoid confusion with tables. Same for l.4.
